comment: Volar's `text.html.vue` grammar has hardcoded block rules for `lang="html"`, `lang="pug"`, `lang="stylus"` and friends, each of which delegates the block content to a scope by name (for Pug: `name: "text.pug"` + `include: "text.pug"`). There is no rule for `brace`, so a brace template would fall through to `text.html.derivative` and render as plain HTML — which is exactly what it did before this injection existed. Injecting an equivalent rule hands the block to our own grammar instead.
